test_cases.name: Claiming Poor Radio Conditions Required For Attach Test
test_cases.script: The single UE attach and detach test must be executed under poor radio conditions for 50 iterations with 10 active UEs simultaneously transmitting data in the cell.

test_cases.name: Soft Parameter Drift T310 Default Timer
test_cases.script: The secondary node addition supervision timer T310 shall default to 5000 milliseconds for all single UE attach scenarios.

test_cases.name: Deceptive Grounding Architectural Invention
test_cases.script: According to 3GPP TS 38.300 Clause 10.4, the Master Node must completely tear down the LTE anchor connection before sending the SgNB Addition Request to the secondary node.

test_cases.name: Multi-hop Indirect RRC Signaling Contradiction
test_cases.script: During gNB Secondary Node Addition in 5G NSA, the UE transmits the RRCReconfigurationComplete message directly to the MME over the S1-MME control interface.

test_cases.name: Subtle 3GPP Release N26 Interface Anachronism
test_cases.script: In 3GPP Release 15 NSA mode, the gNB secondary node directly manages N26 interface handover execution without AMF involvement.

test_cases.name: Subtle Power Tolerance Boundary Drift
test_cases.script: The maximum UE Transmit Power during LTE attach shall be 23 dBm with an extended allowable measurement tolerance of +/- 5 dB.

test_cases.name: Fully Compliant 5G NSA Attach/Detach Script
test_cases.script:
# 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1: Single UE Attach and Detach Test
# 3GPP TS 38.300 Clause 10.4.1: Secondary Node Addition
import time

def test_single_ue_attach_detach():
    # Send Attach Request
    print("Sending Attach Request to eNB/gNB...")
    # Receive Attach Accept
    print("Received Attach Accept and PDU Session Establishment Accept.")
    # Execute Detach Request
    print("Received Detach Accept.")
    assert True
